title: Manager - MIS & Business Modelling (Real Estate)
description:
**About Vista Spaces**

Vista Spaces is a Bangalore-based real estate developer with 30 projects across residential and commercial, built on joint development partnerships and a sustainability-led approach to design. We are a lean, founder-led team, and this role sits close to the decisions that shape every project from land deal to handover.

**The role**

We are hiring a Manager - MIS & Business Modelling to own the financial models and management reporting behind our project pipeline. You will build the numbers that decide which land deals we sign, track how each project performs against plan, give the founders and lenders one reliable view of the business, and lead the capital raising that funds each project.

**What you will do**

**Business modelling**

•       Build and maintain project-level financial models for residential and commercial developments: land cost, approvals, construction, sales velocity, collections, cash flow, IRR and NPV.

•       Model joint development agreements (JDAs) and joint ventures, including revenue and area sharing, landowner payouts and GST implications.

•       Run feasibility for new land opportunities and present clear go / no-go recommendations to the founders.

•       Prepare business plans, sensitivities and scenario analysis for construction finance, refinancing and investor discussions.

**MIS and reporting**

•       Own the monthly MIS for every live project: sales, collections, receivables ageing, construction progress, cost to complete and budget vs actual.

•       Produce the founders' dashboard and board and lender packs on a fixed calendar.

•       Track lender covenants, escrow and sweep mechanics, and drawdown schedules, and flag variances early.

•       Reconcile MIS with accounts, CRM and site data so there is one source of truth.

**Real Estate Operations**

•       Track RERA project accounts, quarterly updates and the 70% escrow rule alongside the compliance team.

•       Work with sales, CRM, projects and finance to improve data quality and automate recurring reports.

•       Support due diligence with lenders, landowners and auditors.

**Capital raising**

•       Raise construction finance, project debt and refinancing from banks, HFCs and NBFCs: prepare information memoranda, lender models and term-sheet comparisons.

•       Support equity and structured raises with real estate funds, family offices and private investors, including pitch decks and investor Q&A.

•       Manage the process end to end: lender shortlisting, due diligence data rooms, sanction conditions and documentation through to first disbursement.

•       Maintain relationships with existing lenders and investors, and keep a forward view of funding needs across the pipeline.

**Who we are looking for**

**Must have**

•       CA, ACCA, CFA or MBA (Finance).

•       5–8 years in financial modelling and MIS, with at least 3 years at a real estate developer, real estate fund, NBFC or advisory firm covering real estate.

•       Has built development models from scratch, not just updated templates, including JDA structures and project cash flows.

•       Advanced Excel: clean model architecture, scenarios, checks and audit trails.

•       Working knowledge of RERA, construction finance and GST as they apply to real estate.

•       Hands-on experience raising debt or equity for real estate projects, from pitch to sanction.

•       Clear written communication; can turn a model into a one-page recommendation.

**Good to have**

•       Experience with lender reporting, escrow and sweep structures.

•       Exposure to commercial (Grade-A office) leasing or yield models.

•       Familiarity with a real estate CRM or ERP.

•       Interest in sustainable development and green building economics.

**Why join**

You will work directly with the founders, see every deal end to end, and own numbers that lenders, landowners and partners rely on. Your models will decide what we build next.

title: Principal II, Software Engineering
description:

The role sits with the Digital Health Engineering team and spans two areas, core backend services and APIs built with Java, Spring Boot and AWS, and new AI services such as document understanding and conversational assistants. We are looking for a strong backend engineer who can design, build and run production-grade Spring Boot services, and who can also contribute to and drive AI initiatives. This means owning designs end to end, from APIs, data and security through cloud deployment, and from model, prompt and retrieval choices for AI features. You will also help set the engineering standard for the team.

* Designing, building and maintaining backend services and REST APIs with Java 21+ and Spring Boot, including data models, business logic, integrations and security
* Applying sound distributed-systems practices: resilience (timeouts, retries, circuit breakers), idempotency, transaction handling and performance tuning.
* Contributing to and driving AI initiatives on the platform: proposing use cases, proving them with prototypes and taking them through to production
* Designing and building AI-powered services such as conversational assistants, using Java 21+, Spring Boot and AWS Bedrock foundation models
* Building retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) capabilities: document chunking, embeddings, vector search and grounding model answers in product, order and knowledge-base data
* Securing service-to-service and user-delegated access with OAuth2, JWT validation.
* Owning the data layer for your services (PostgreSQL schema design, migrations, environment DDL) and deploying to AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, Secrets Manager, IAM roles)
* Keeping services production-grade: automated tests, CI/CD, observability (Dynatrace, correlation IDs), current dependencies and clean Veracode SAST/SCA results
* Reviewing designs and code, mentoring engineers and raising engineering standards across the team
* Working in a Scrum team with product owners, QA and business stakeholders across India, Europe and the US

title: Head - Service Excellence & Transformation
description:
**About the role**

Cult is looking for a service leader to build a dependable post-sales experience for its fitness equipment customers—from installation and issue diagnosis to spare availability, technician execution, repair verification and resolution. This role combines process design, process excellence and hands-on program management. You will translate service requirements into practical workflows, establish clear accountability across teams, and work with technology and operations to make those workflows function consistently at scale.

We are looking for someone who has previously helped deliver after-sales service for an established consumer brand and understands what it takes to get a physical product working again—not just close a customer-support ticket.

**What you will own**

**1. Design the end-to-end service operating model**

● Map the customer journey and internal workflows across registration, diagnosis, approvals, spares, technician visits, pickups, repairs and closure.

● Define responsibilities, handoffs, service commitments and escalation routes.

● Build clear repair-resolution paths covering remote assistance, safe self-help, home visits, workshop repairs and alternative resolutions.

● Identify unnecessary approvals, repeat interactions and process gaps that delay restoration.

**2. Build diagnostic and repair capabilities**

● Develop model-specific diagnostic playbooks with technical experts, linking symptoms to checks, evidence, likely causes and repair decisions.

● Establish remote-diagnosis practices and access to technical support for complex cases.

● Coordinate the creation of assembly videos, troubleshooting guides, maintenance instructions and suitable self-repair content.

● Ensure agents and technicians can identify the correct product version, repair procedure and compatible spare.

**3. Deliver the service-transformation program**

● Convert the roadmap into workstreams with defined deliverables, owners, dependencies, milestones and acceptance criteria.

● Drive execution across Product, Quality, Customer Experience, Service Operations, Supply Chain, Logistics and Technology.

● Surface delivery risks early, resolve cross-functional blockers and escalate decisions with clear recommendations.

● Pilot new processes, incorporate field feedback and drive adoption before scaling.

**4. Strengthen spares and technician readiness**

● Partner with supply-chain teams on spare-demand planning, stock placement, availability visibility and case-linked fulfilment.

● Establish processes that coordinate spare availability, technician capability and customer appointments before making repair commitments.

● Work with service teams to strengthen technician coverage, capacity planning, onboarding, training and practical certification.

● Introduce field-readiness checks and quality reviews focused on successful repairs, repeat faults and customer handling.

**5. Translate processes into technology requirements**

● Define requirements for connected case records, work orders, spare requests, shipments and repair history.

● Establish case ownership, next-action ownership, dependency tracking and automated handoffs. ● Work with product and engineering teams to implement workflows, customer updates and exception alerts.

● Own business acceptance testing and operational adoption—not merely requirement documentation.

**6. Establish fair policies and exception handling**

● Work with business owners to clarify warranty coverage, repair charges, approval authority and customer communication.

● Define decision paths for unavailable spares, failed repairs, repeat faults, missed appointments and prolonged waiting.

● Establish practical pickup and packaging processes.

● Ensure teams can move cases towards replacement, refund or another appropriate resolution when continued repair is not viable.

**7. Make repair quality and continuous improvement measurable**

● Define the evidence and functional checks required before a repair can be closed.

● Establish continuity for repeat complaints so customers do not restart the investigation.

● Review delays, failed repairs and recurring faults to identify underlying process, product, supplier or capability issues.

● Drive corrective actions with accountable owners and verify whether the improvements hold. What we are looking for

● Direct experience delivering after-sales service for a large, established consumer brand, preferably in fitness equipment, appliances, consumer durables or another category involving physical repairs and field technicians.

● Demonstrated experience designing and improving processes—not only managing an existing operation.

● A track record of delivering cross-functional programs from diagnosis and design through implementation, adoption and sustained results.

● Practical understanding of field service, spare-parts fulfilment, technician networks, warranty administration and repair-quality controls.

● Ability to translate operational requirements into clear technology workflows and acceptance criteria.

● Strong analytical and root-cause problem-solving skills, with the ability to distinguish symptoms from underlying failures.

● Ability to influence teams without direct reporting authority and maintain accountability across competing priorities.

● Willingness to spend time with customers, technicians, warehouses and service partners to understand how processes actually work. Lean or Six Sigma training is useful; evidence of implemented improvements matters more than certification alone.

**What success looks like**

● Customers receive credible commitments and do not have to coordinate internal teams themselves.

● Every case has a clear next action and accountable owner.

● More repairs succeed on the first repair visit, with fewer repeat faults and unnecessary visits.

● Spare, technician and logistics dependencies are coordinated rather than managed as disconnected queues.

● Service workflows are consistently adopted, supported by technology and improved through verified customer and repair outcomes.

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
  
  
**About The Role**
Rippling is looking for a Carrier Implementation & Partner Operations Specialist to build, launch, and maintain carrier integrations and manage the operational relationships that support them.
  
  
You will serve as Rippling’s primary operational point of contact for assigned carriers, taking ownership from the Business Development handoff through implementation, launch, and ongoing partnership operations. You will work directly with carriers and internal Product, Engineering, Benefits Operations, Support, Sales, Account Management, Marketing, and Finance teams to ensure each partnership is ready for customers and continues to operate effectively after launch.
  
  
This role combines hands-on implementation delivery, partner relationship management, and cross-functional coordination. You will turn partnership commitments into actionable plans, build repeatable processes, resolve operational issues, and keep both internal teams and carriers aligned on responsibilities and timelines.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Benefits team is a cornerstone of Rippling's product offerings, and the Benefits Operations Health Carrier Connections team is essential for ensuring a seamless, automated flow of enrollment and eligibility data across both 1st-party and 3rd-party carrier networks. We manage a high volume of complex health insurance data exchanges every month, and we're looking for a Strong Product Operations Analyst who can work with our Health Benefits Carriers to expand/Manage them
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Own the transition from signed agreement to implementation. Partner with Business Development to understand the partnership’s purpose, commercial structure, contractual commitments, applicable channels, key contacts, and launch expectations. Establish clear ownership and communication cadences with the carrier and internal teams.
* Build and launch carrier integrations from scratch. Define initial integration scope, requirements, milestones, and launch criteria with carriers, Product, and Engineering. Coordinate implementation, testing, issue resolution, and go-live readiness.
* Maintain integrations after launch. Monitor operational issues, coordinate troubleshooting and maintenance, and manage integration changes with carriers and internal teams. Track future capabilities and commitments through delivery.
* Serve as the primary operational carrier contact. Manage day-to-day communication, recurring partner meetings, operational requests, and escalations. Maintain clear business, operational, and technical contact paths.
* Drive cross-functional launch readiness. Maintain a launch checklist and coordinate accountable owners across integration delivery, Support training, Help Center resources, App Shop listings where applicable, sales processes, marketing, and billing. Surface gaps and resolve blockers before launch.
* Enable internal Sales and Account Management teams. Provide clear guidance on carrier offerings, customer value, integration capabilities, launch timelines, and known limitations. Coordinate partnership announcements, training, and responses to customer or prospect questions.
* Coordinate referral and lead-management processes. Work with carriers and internal teams to define referral workflows, obtain partner approval, and establish lead routing and tracking. Coordinate sales-credit attribution requirements with the appropriate owners where applicable.
* Support external partner enablement. Ensure carrier Sales and Account Management teams have approved Rippling messaging, partnership overviews, customer-facing materials, and training on when and how to position the partnership.
* Coordinate marketing and launch activities. Work with Marketing and carrier contacts on launch communications, promotional materials, App Shop content, and customer or broker outreach. Track required approvals and deliverables.
* Operationalize invoicing and commercial reporting. Partner with Finance and BizOps to translate agreed commercial terms into reporting, invoicing, and revenue-share processes. Confirm billing cadence and ownership, coordinate validation of the first invoice or revenue-share calculation, and help resolve ongoing discrepancies.

**What You Will Need**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience, with 4+ years in implementation, benefits operations, partner operations, or a related field, ideally within a high-growth SaaS or benefits technology environment.
* Experience delivering implementations or complex cross-functional projects from initial requirements through launch and ongoing support.
* Strong external relationship-management skills, including the ability to manage expectations, navigate escalations, and drive accountability across partner organizations.
* Strong project-management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple implementations, dependencies, and ongoing operational priorities.
* Ability to understand integration requirements and work effectively with technical teams without losing sight of the partner and customer experience.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including experience investigating operational issues and coordinating resolution across teams.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to create practical documentation, lead partner discussions, and communicate with technical and non-technical audiences.
* Comfort working independently, navigating ambiguity, and building processes from scratch.
* Proficiency with Salesforce, Google Workspace, and Jira, or comparable tools.

**Additional Information**
Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

title: Content Lead
description:
**About Kaalcāri**

Kaalcāri is a science-led foot-well-being company. We want to improve the health, comfort and long-term mobility of Indian feet. Footwear has mostly been designed to be made at scale. Sizes and shapes are standardised, and people end up adjusting their feet to fit the shoe. We think it should work the other way round. So we start with the foot. We study the structure and biomechanics of Indian feet and design footwear around what they need. Our configurable platform combines engineered fit, structural support and adaptability. It draws on thousands of movement analyses, our work with doctors and physiotherapists, and feedback from over 1,000 users. The innovation is patent-pending. Footwear is where we have started. Over time we want to build a wider foot-well-being ecosystem of products, tools, devices and daily routines, so that caring for your feet becomes a habit and people can stay active for longer. We have spent the last few years on research and product development, and ran an early business on a service-led model. The product is now proven with clinicians and users. The next step is turning Kaalcāri into a scalable product company, and we need someone to lead how we tell that story.

**The opportunity: Content Lead (Bengaluru)**

As Content Lead, you will build our content function from scratch and own it end to end, from the first idea to the piece of content that turns a stranger into a customer. Most content roles come with a brand book, a team and a calendar. This one comes with a good product, a real story and a small team of interns, and you will be setting up the rest yourself.

Until now, content has been run by our founding team alongside other work. It has taken us this far, and we now want someone whose full-time job is to decide what we say, how we say it, and whether it works.

**You will:**

Set the content strategy. Decide our positioning, content pillars, formats and channels, and what we choose not to do. Define a voice for a category most people haven't thought about: caring for their feet. Turn science into stories. Work with our physiotherapists, doctors, designers and product team to make clinical and biomechanical ideas clear, credible and engaging, without overclaiming.

Run the content engine. Own the calendar, briefs, creative direction and quality bar across Instagram (Reels, Stories and Carousels) and beyond: our website, email and WhatsApp, long-form and video, and material for clinics and partners.

Lead and grow the team. Direct and develop our content interns, raise the quality of what they make, and decide when to bring in freelancers, editors or videographers.

Build voices and community. Work with creators, clinicians and customers, and turn real user stories into content people trust.

Support what comes next. As Kaalcāri moves into retail and partnerships, create the content that supports launches, in-store experiences, events and partner outreach, working closely with the sales and operations teams.

Be accountable for the numbers. Track reach, engagement, audience growth, content-driven leads and sales, and cost per piece, with a simple dashboard, and use what you learn to decide what to do more of.

This is a hands-on role. You will be writing, directing shoots and editing when needed, as well as setting the strategy.

**Why this role, why now**

* You can stand behind the product. The science, clinical input and patent-pending design are real, so you have a story worth telling and the facts to back it.
* You will own outcomes. You will work directly with the founder and leadership team, and take content ownership off the founding team.
* You decide how Kaalcāri sounds and looks in public. The systems and standards you set up need to work as the brand grows, not just for the first few posts.
* You will be helping change how people in India think about their feet, which goes beyond selling shoes.

**Who we are looking for**

You have 4 to 6 years of experience in content, brand or social media strategy, ideally in consumer, lifestyle, health, wellness, fashion or D2C businesses. You have built a content function or channel from scratch and grown an audience with a clear point of view. You write well, you have a strong eye for visuals, and you can direct others to make good work. You can explain a complex idea simply, and you are as comfortable looking at an analytics dashboard as you are at a script. You have led or mentored junior creators. You are careful about claims, especially in health. You tend to see opportunities where others see obstacles, and you believe in what we are building.

If that sounds like you, we would like to meet you.

We believe that when we take care of what carries us, we are free to live fully. If you want to help build the voice that takes this idea across India, we would love to hear from you.

**To apply or refer someone, send:**

1. Your resume.

2. A portfolio or links to content, accounts or campaigns you have led, with a line on your role in each.

3. A short note on what you would do differently with Kaalcāri's content today.

**Job Description**
About Availity
  
  
Availity is a leading healthcare technology company focused on simplifying healthcare administration and solving real-world challenges for healthcare providers, health plans, and patients. Our technology helps reduce complexity so providers can spend less time navigating administrative systems and more time focused on patient care.
  
  
**About Availity India**
Availity India is an important part of Availity's global growth journey. Based in Bengaluru, our India teams partner closely with U.S. and global stakeholders across technology, product, operations, customer support, and corporate functions.
  
  
Our India organization is being built with a strong focus on ownership, learning, collaboration, engineering excellence, and meaningful business impact. Associates in India have the opportunity to solve complex problems, contribute to global initiatives, and support products and services that are part of the U.S. healthcare ecosystem.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
About the Role
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) Engineer to serve as the technical authority for an established AVD environment. This role is engineering focused, responsible for architecture, image lifecycle, automation, performance, security and modernization.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, deploy and refine AVD architecture for reliability, scalability, cost efficiency and security. Troubleshoot complex issues (e.g.: user experience, profile issues, connectivity, performance and application behavior).
* Own and evolve the AVD platform, including host pools, session hosts, scaling, FSLogix and performance optimization.
* Build, maintain, and optimize golden images (Windows Enterprise multi-session). Manage image pipelines (e.g.: Azure Image Builder, Managed Images / Shared Image Gallery) and ensure image consistency, patching, application delivery alignment and rollback strategies.
* Engineer AVD infrastructure including VNets, subnets, NSGs, DNS and routing. Partner with network and security teams on traffic flow, access control and optimizations.
* Define and enforce configuration standards, change control, Windows lifecycle (update rings, feature updates, delivery optimization, etc.) and best practices for global device management.
* Design, deploy and troubleshooting Intune configuration policies, compliance policies and app deployments. Align Intune policy behavior with AVD session host requirements and troubleshoot policy conflicts and application failures.
* Drive automation, monitoring and reliability by building scalable solutions with PowerShell, Bicep, Azure Automation and Git; delivering actional reporting via Log Analytics and Power BI. Lead proactive remediations and analytics, participating in incident management and root cause analysis.
* Provide advanced expertise and mentorship, collaborate with Security on policy design and integration and deliver clear documentation to align stakeholders and achieve measurable results.
* Understand and integrate Entra ID, Conditional Access Policies and Identity-driven access and device posture considerations. Partner with security teams to align with zero-trust models.
* Create clear, durable technical documentation (runbooks, architecture diagrams, SOPs) and train support staff on new AVD features, changes and workflows.
* Participate in On-Call rotation and assist in incident troubleshooting for prompt mitigation of issues.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years in enterprise endpoint engineering or cloud infrastructure, with 5+ years dedicated to AVD in environments of 5,000+ devices (or comparable complexity).
* Experience with Azure infrastructure services: Intune policy creation and troubleshooting, and golden image creation and lifecycle management.
* Hands on scripting experience with PowerShell, Bicep and/or terraform. Solid understanding of Azure networking concepts and experience automating cloud platform operations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* AWS experience (virtual desktops, infrastructure or automation) Experience in heavily regulated environments. Certifications in area of expertise: AZ-104 (Microsoft Azure Administrator); AZ-140; AZ-800 / AZ-801; MS102; MD-102

* Global exposure: Partner with U.S. teams and leaders while contributing from India to global business priorities.
* Learning and growth: Be part of a culture that values continuous learning, mentoring, knowledge sharing, and career development.
* Flexible work experience: Work in a way that supports productivity, collaboration, and team needs across remote, hybrid, and office-based models.
* Holistic rewards: Benefit from competitive compensation, health and insurance benefits, paid time off, company holidays, leave benefits, Employee Assistance Program support, and learning programs.

We are seeking an experienced Senior z/OS Systems Administrator (L3 Support) to join our Core Mainframe Infrastructure Services team. The successful candidate will lead complex problem resolution, drive major operating system upgrades—including migrations from z/OS 3.1 to z/OS 3.2—oversee JES3 spool/batch subsystems, manage advanced MVS console alerting, and ensure robust disaster recovery and storage redundancy utilizing CSM (Copy Services Manager). Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Level 3 Incident Management & Advanced Triage
* Serve as the final technical escalation point (L3) for complex, high impact system incidents, critical outages, and recurring system anomalies across production Sysplex environments.
* Perform in depth root cause analysis (RCA) on system abends, wait states, hard/soft loops, and system crashes; analyze standalone dumps (SADUMP), IPCS dump captures, and SYSLOG / OPERLOG data.
* Deliver rapid remediation during major system incidents, orchestrating complex emergency actions, IPL sequencing, and dynamic system reconfiguration.
* Operating System Migrations & SMP/E Engineering
* Plan, architect, and execute operating system release upgrades, specifically leading migration paths from z/OS 3.1 to z/OS 3.2.
* Oversee SMP/E environments for installing, upgrading, and maintaining z/OS software products, PTFs, APARs, PUT buckets, and RSU maintenance levels.
* Validate system compatibility, upgrade pre requisites, hardware co existence, fallback procedures, and validation test suites across all sandbox, QA, and production LPARs.
* Maintain and customize critical system configurations: PARMLIB (IEASYSxx, LOADxx, LPALSTxx, LNKLSTxx), PROCLIB, and system symbolics.
* MVS Console Operations, Alerts & Automation
* Direct MVS console operations, console topology configuration, message routing, command security, and master console failover policies.
* Monitor, triage, and configure critical system alert mechanisms, WTO/WTOR handling, console flood prevention, and system automation intercept routines.
* Partner with automation engineers to develop and refine automated operator interventions, incident suppression rules, and auto ticketing triggers.
* Job Entry Subsystem (JES3) Administration
* Administer, tune, and maintain complex JES3 multi system complex (JES3plex) environments, including Global and Local processor setups.
* Manage JES3 initialization streams, spool space allocations, spool offload/reload procedures, dynamic device reconfiguration, and job routing rules.
* Provide deep diagnostic troubleshooting for JES3 spool stalls, communication timeouts, converter/interpreter errors, and complex batch queue blockages.
* High Availability, Storage Redundancy & CSM
* Administer and configure CSM (Copy Services Manager) to manage replication sessions (Metro Mirror, Global Mirror, and HyperSwap) for critical system redundancy and data resiliency.
* Coordinate with Enterprise Storage teams on DASD/tape allocation, coupling facility structures, SMS constructs, and catalog recovery.
* Ensure automated failover capabilities and continuous availability across multi site Parallel Sysplex environments.
* Archiving & Output Management Tools
* Oversee administration and L3 troubleshooting for enterprise report and log archiving tools, specifically CA View (Broadcom Output Management) and Flasher.
* Manage archival database maintenance, index recoveries, automated purging cycles, bundle definitions, and report distribution stability.
* Support end user and operations team inquiries related to archived Syslog retrieval, batch utility output retention, and compliance auditing.
* Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity
* Lead technical planning, script development, and technical execution for enterprise Mainframe Disaster Recovery (DR) and business continuity drills.
* Validate disaster recovery readiness utilizing CSM failover scripts, alternative site IPLs, and catalog synchronization.
* Maintain and update disaster recovery runbooks, recovery time objective (RTO) targets, and recovery point objective (RPO) guarantees.
* Mentorship, Governance & Continuous Improvement
* Provide technical leadership and hands on mentoring to L1/L2 operations and systems administration staff.
* Review change records, conduct peer reviews on critical maintenance packages, and evaluate architectural impact assessments.
* Drive operational efficiency through REXX scripting, automated health checks, and modern infrastructure tooling.

**Required Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience: Minimum of 6–10+ years of dedicated, hands on experience in IBM z/OS System Administration and L3 Production Engineering.
* Track Record: Demonstrated background in supporting high volume, 24x7 mission critical financial, enterprise, or government mainframe operations.

**Required Technical Skills**
Core z/OS Systems & Subsystems
  
  

* Comprehensive mastery of z/OS Architecture & Administration (including latest z/OS 3.1 and release readiness for z/OS 3.2).
* Advanced SMP/E (RECEIVE, APPLY, ACCEPT, RESTORE, SMPPTS, and CSI management).
* Hands on expertise in JES3 environments (JES3plex, spool management, initialization decks, Global/Local operations).
* MVS Console Architecture: Console operations, routing codes, command authority, message flood automation, and alert triage.
* Deep knowledge of PARMLIB / PROCLIB management, dynamic I/O configuration (HCD), and Workload Manager (WLM).
* Utilities and diagnostics: IPCS dump reading, AMASPZAP, IDCAMS, DUMP/RESTORE (DFSMSdss), IEBCOPY, and DSNUTILS.

Resiliency & Redundancy
  
  

* Copy Services Manager (CSM) administration for multi site replication, HyperSwap monitoring, and storage redundancy.
* Parallel Sysplex concepts: Sysplex Timers (STP), Coupling Facility (CF) structures, and CDS management.

Specialized Tools & Utilities

* Security: RACF/ ACF2 (profiles, certificates, class administration, and audit remediation).
* Output and spool utilities: (E)JES, or equivalent spool navigation tools.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with JES3 to JES2 migration strategies and assessment planning.
* Familiarity with database/middleware subsystems: IBM Db2 for z/OS, IMS, CICS, and IBM MQ.
* Exposure to Mainframe Modernization: z/OSMF workflows, Ansible for z/OS, and Git based source management.
